key_insight: A PDE-consistent deep neural network closure, trained jointly with the LES solver, can outperform classical eddy-viscosity modeling for turbulent premixed flames and remain robust across Damköhler-number regimes.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path to more accurate and transferable LES models for turbulent combustion, improving predictions of mean fields and turbulence statistics without breaking solver consistency.
method: Augmented eddy-viscosity closure learned with deep neural networks
Adjoint-based optimization and differentiable programming inside the LES loop
Objective functions compared for interpolation and extrapolation across Damköhler numbers
evidence_signal: Compared with the Smagorinsky baseline, the best model reduced a posteriori errors by 25–50% in primitive variables and by more than 60% in resolved Reynolds stress and scalar flux, while remaining stable out of sample.
watch_item: Performance depends on solver-integrated training and calibration, so transfer to new geometries, chemistry, or flow regimes may still require retraining and careful stability checks.
paper_title: Solver-in-the-loop training of deep learning closures for large-eddy simulation of turbulent premixed jet flames
